name: Clear
rules:
## Individual Level Rules

* All individual level runs should either have the in-game timer enabled, or in the case that you do not have it enabled:

  * for the duration of the run, have livesplit showing file/chapter time to the hundredths of a second
  * **AND** turn chapter or file time on before going to the chapter complete screen.

* Every run must complete the chapter from start to finish.
* Retrying or similar means of resetting the timer to skip gameplay is not allowed in 7A, 7B, 8A and 8C.
* Save and Quits to replace retries, beneficially alter cycles, or after screen transition Badeline throws are banned.
* The Chapter Complete screen has to be shown at the end.

name: Any Heat
rules:
## **Any Heat Rules**

1. Achieve Victory using any amount of heat (0 or more).  

2. Must be a single, continuous run. 
No game quit-outs (Alt-F4s, give-ups, quits or crashes) mid-run.

3. Any Mirror, Weapon/Aspect or starting Keepsake can be used. 
You are encouraged to unlock all of these, but it is not necessary.

_______________________________________
Leaderboards are ordered by fastest In Game Time (IGT). 
Real Time is not *required* for this category, but the leaderboard can be sorted by Real Time. 
Your Real Time Attack (RTA) starts as soon as you can move after dropping out of the window at the start of the escape. RTA ends the instant the final boss dies.
_______________________________________

name: Any%
rules:
**Category specific rules**

- Finish the game as fast as possible. Timing begins on first input and ends when the Spider Mastermind glory kill is performed.

- For submissions to classic (the default), you may play on any of the first three difficulties. If you select Nightmare or Ultra-Nightmare, make sure you select the respective difficulty when you create your submission.

- For Ultra-Nightmare submissions, the beginning of the game starts in a different place. The timer begins when you take control of Doomguy leaving the elevator.

- For general rules, read: Main Rules.

**Category specific rules**

Complete the below requirements and finish the game as fast as possible.

100%:

- Full Combat-Rating for all levels that measure it (Foundry and onward)
- Master all weapons 
- Master all runes
- Collect all secrets 
- Collect all codices
- Collect all Argent Cell upgrades
- Fully upgrade the Praetor Suit with the use of Praetor Tokens
- Perform all optional challenges for levels that measure it (Resource Operations and onward)


FOR CLASSIC & NIGHTMARE ONLY:

End-screen capture after glory-killing the Spider Mastermind:
- 11 Combat Points 
- All weapon masteries
- All argent cells, Praetor-suit upgrades
- All runes mastered
- All Codices

If checking before Spider Mastermind GK you should have the following:

* Environments 25/25
* Database 9/9
* UAC Personnel 9/9
* Weapons 27/27
* Monsters 35/36
* Artifacts 16/16

If not showing before the Spider Mastermind: please show that you collect all of the above in your video submission by launching into the game after the run has been completed and showing your menu and scrolling through every menu option.


FOR ULTRA-NIGHTMARE ONLY:

You must show the end-screen capture before glory-killing the Spider Mastermind (doing so after glory killing the Spider Mastermind is not possible). You must have all of the following:
- 11 Combat Points 
- All masteries for weapons
- All argent cells and Prateor-suit upgrades
- All masteries for runes
- All codices possible for Ultra-Nightmare:

- Environments 25/25
- Database 9/9
- UAC Personnel 9/9
- Weapons 25/27
- Monsters 35/36
- Artifacts 15/16

name: Legacy
rules:
Finish game as fast as possible without the use of below glitches/skips/tricks. Timer starts when you gain control in the Intro and ends when Spider Mastermind Glory Kill is performed.

**Disallowed glitches/skips/tricks**

- Railboosts. 
- Glory Kill Clips
- Paperclips
- Weapon Wheel Glitch (using the Weapon Wheel while a BFG shot is in the air)
- Animation delay using the weapon wheel (eg. ARC tram clip, VEGA tether delay, etc.)
- Pressing buttons/switches through walls or surfaces. (Glitched buttons such as the one at the very end of Lazarus 1 are allowed, but you must shoot the panel off of the button first.)
- Chainsawing the imp through the elevator window during the elevator ride in Lazarus 1, or the zombies that are outside of the door in the second room coming out of the elevator.

If you have any questions about the ruleset, please ask a mod in the Discord.

**What is Legacy?** 

Legacy is the newest version of what used to be known as "No Major Glitches" Since there is such a grey area in defining what is or is not a "glitch" in this game, a group of DOOM runners voted to define a set of rules that they would all abide by. It is important that all players use the same rules, since it allows them to compare times with each other. These rules are not perfect, but they are the current standard.

name: IL Runs
rules: Follow the rules for each individual level

name: All Secrets
rules:
**Category specific rules**

- Collect all secrets in each level and finish the game as fast as possible. Timing begins on first input and ends when the Spider Mastermind glory kill is performed.

- For verification purposes its required to show the secrets in your submission video after a run is finished. To do this, return back to the Main Menu after the credits. Open your save and scroll through each level. The secrets are shown at the bottom of each level as "?" icons.

- You may play on any difficulty, aside from Nightmare & Ultra-Nightmare as they are their own category.

- For general rules, read: Main Rules.

name: New Game +
rules:
**Category specific rules**

- Use the "Level Select" option to complete all 13 levels in order. 
- Using LiveSplit, the timer auto-starts when you gain control in the elevator of "The UAC" and ends automatically when initiating the glory kill on the Spider Mastermind.
- For general rules, read: Main Rules.

**Misc**

- You are allowed to use a save file with any amount of game completion, and use weapons/runes etc. to your advantage as you please.

name: 0% (Full CR)
rules:
**Category specific rules**

- Timer starts when player takes control and ends when Spider Mastermind Glory Kill is performed.

- End screen confirmation for each level must be captured. The End screen confirmation is required before Spider Mastermind glory kill.

- Using mods to open the final door in Resource Operations leading to the end-level trigger is **not** allowed.

1. Full combat rating per level that tracks it.
2. Cannot spend weapon upgrade points
3. Cannot acquire weapon mods
4. Cannot acquire argent cells
5. Cannot acquire Praetor Tokens
6. Cannot acquire runes
7. Cannot access any level's secrets
8. Cannot make any progress towards any level's Optional Mission Challenges

name: Redguard
rules:
Timer starts when player takes control and ends when Spider Mastermind Glory Kill is performed. The console is not allowed to be used in any way.

All praetor tokens from all levels must be obtained. You may display this after the credits in the Level Select screen.

name: Max Exploration
rules:
**Category specific rules**

- Collect all collectibles in each level and finish the game as fast as possible.
This can be reviewed under the end screen's 'Exploration' tab and exists out of: Secrets, Praetor Suit tokens, Rune's and Argent Cells. (Combat Rating is excluded) 
 
Timing begins on first input and ends when the Spider Mastermind glory kill is performed.

When submitting: 
- After completing a run, a runner must show the progress of each level in the Level Select screen.

Restrictions:
- Duping redguard tokens, weapon drones, and argent cells is not allowed. Duping weapon drones and argent cells would softlock the player from gathering all collectibles. Duping redguard tokens will not softlock the player but all tokens must be acquired at source regardless.

Other:
- You may play on any difficulty, aside from Nightmare & Ultra-Nightmare as they are their own category.

- For general rules, read: "Main Rules".

name: Out of Bounds
rules:
[OoB category rules](https://www.speedrun.com/portal#Out_of_Bounds) apply.  

The following speed caps apply to the very start of all Individual Levels:

-Your horizontal (xy) speed cannot be more than 280 (this is about the maximum speed of a jump, with strafing). 

-Your vertical (z) speed must be between -250 and 150 (This is the speed range when crouch jumping and landing on the same elevation). 

For *escape 01*, you can't have more speed going into the map than crouch jumping off the rail into the trigger would give you (cannot have more than -445.50 z speed. Example of too much speed would be -455.00).

Individual level runs have to be single segment and start on the inbounds level load (e.g. no under or in front of elevator start). You must not start in saveglitch state. No saving/loading. No props from the previous map. You cannot start your Individual Level through New Game. **Demo proof is required to submit** (video is optional).

name: Inbounds
rules:
Full game Inbounds rules apply

The following speed caps apply to the very start of all Individual Levels:

-Your horizontal (xy) speed cannot be more than 280 (this is about the maximum speed of a jump, with strafing).

-Your vertical (z) speed must be between -250 and 150 (This is the speed range when crouch jumping and landing on the same elevation).

For *escape 01*, you can't have more speed going into the map than crouch jumping off the rail into the trigger would give you (cannot have more than -445.50 z speed. Example of too much speed would be -455.00).

Individual level runs have to be single segment and start on the inbounds level load (e.g. no under or in front of elevator start). You must not start in saveglitch state. No saving/loading. No props from the previous map. Obtaining AGSG state is allowed. You cannot start your Individual Level through New Game. **Demo proof is required to submit** (video is optional).

name: Out of Bounds
rules:
# **Out of Bounds Rules**

Beat the game, all out of bounds tricks are allowed.

name: Inbounds
rules:
# **Inbounds Rules**

Beat the game without having any props, your camera, placed portals or traveling portals leave the map. 

If any of those conditions are broken, you need to reload a save (however, shooting a portal through oob space that doesn't land anywhere or accidentally doing clipping glitch in maps like 10 is OK).

name: Inbounds No SLA
rules:
# Inbounds No Saveload Abuse Rules

Beat the game without having any props, your camera, placed portals or traveling portals leave the map.

You are NOT allowed to do any glitch/trick/route that requires you to utilize loading (this includes autosaves, map transitions, and New Game). You're still allowed to use quicksaves, but everything in your run needs to be theoretically possible without using saving/loading.

If any of those conditions are broken, you need to reload a save (however, shooting a portal through oob space that doesn't land anywhere or accidentally doing clipping glitch in maps like 10 is OK).

All glitches are allowed as long as they do not require saving and loading.

name: Inbounds Legacy
rules:
# **Inbounds Legacy Rules**

Beat the game without having any props, your camera, placed portals or traveling portals leave the map.

You are NOT allowed to do any glitch/trick/route that requires you to utilize loading (this includes autosaves, map transitions, and New Game).
You're still allowed to use quicksaves, but everything in your run needs to be theoretically possible without using saving/loading.

Vault Skip is banned.
Vertical Angle Glitches are banned.
Angle Glitch Save Glitch may only be obtained if it is cancelled by the next shot and provides no further benefit to player positioning or portal placement.
Seamshots are banned, except [this specific one in chamber 17](https://youtu.be/AwZCE1JPoLI).
In-game sensitivity must not exceed 10.0.

If any of those conditions are broken, you need to reload a save (however, shooting a portal through oob space that doesn't land anywhere or accidentally doing clipping glitch in maps like 10 is OK).

name: Legacy
rules:
[Inbounds category rules](https://www.speedrun.com/portal#Inbounds) apply.  

The following speed caps apply to the very start of all Individual Levels:

-Your horizontal (xy) speed cannot be more than 280 (this is about the maximum speed of a jump, with strafing). 

-Your vertical (z) speed must be between -250 and 150 (This is the speed range when crouch jumping and landing on the same elevation). 

For *escape 01*, you can't have more speed going into the map than crouch jumping off the rail into the trigger would give you (cannot have more than -445.50 z speed. Example of too much speed would be -455.00).

Individual level runs have to be single segment and start on the inbounds level load (e.g. no under or in front of elevator start). You must not start in saveglitch state. No saving/loading. No props from the previous map. Obtaining AGSG state is allowed. You cannot start your Individual Level through New Game. 
**Demo proof is required to submit** (video is optional).

rules:

Individual level runs have to be single segment and start on the inbounds level load (e.g. no under or in front of elevator start). You must not start in saveglitch state. No saving/loading. No props from the previous map. Portal boosts are not allowed to be used, even if they are by accident. You cannot start your Individual Level through New Game.
**Demo proof is required to submit** (video is optional).

name: Glitchless
rules:
# **Glitchless Rules**

Beat the game, using none of the glitches listed below.

Banned glitches include, but are not limited to:

- Any method of going OoB/placing portals OoB, as defined in the [Inbounds rules](https://www.speedrun.com/portal/full_game#Inbounds)
- Any form of Save Load Abuse, as defined in the [Inbounds No SLA rules](https://www.speedrun.com/portal#Inbounds_No_SLA)
- Using a sensitivity value over 10.0
- Turret killed Glados
- ABH, AFH, ASH
- Item Climbing or gaining/preserving height from a mid-air prop
- Camera Fly
- Super Object Throw
- Quantum Crouch
- Portal Bumping through objects or entities
- Edge Glitch
- Clipping Glitch
- LAG, AAG, VAG
- Portal Under Door in 09
- Prop and Portal Boosts (accidental boosts are allowed as long as they do not advance you further than possible without glitches)
- Shooting under door at the start of 16
- 11 platform shot
- Item Save Glitch
- Planetary Alignment
- Seamshots
- Infinite Sensitivity / Singularity Warping
- Shooting portals through gaps in elevator geometry, such as pancake shots

If you are unsure about whether something is allowed or not, message a mod or ask in the discord.

name: Any%
rules:
---
Objective
---
Beat the game as fast as possible! 

The run begins after selecting yes on "Start new game", and ends when you collect the final "time piece cluster".

---
Category Specific Rules
---

name: Restricted
rules:
Collect the Time Piece as fast as possible. All general game rules are to be followed, unless otherwise is specified below.

The following restrictions apply to this category:

- All Badges except Hookshot are banned.
- Time Stop hat is banned.
- The use of Death Wish restarts for exploiting is banned.
- The use of Ultra Jumps (via the "Auto-Jump" option) is banned.
- Hypervaults are banned.

The speedrun act timer must be enabled and visible in the recording at all times.

The "restartIL" command from the Speedrun Tools mod, or Console Commands Plus mod, is allowed (and encouraged) for faster resets.

Use of unpatched boop is allowed, even on newer versions of the game.

If the IL is a Death Wish level, peace and tranquility is not allowed to be used.

name: Any%
rules:
Collect the Time Piece as fast as possible. All general game rules are to be followed, unless otherwise is specified below.

The speedrun act timer must be enabled and visible in the recording at all times.

The "restartIL" command from the Speedrun Tools mod, or Console Commands Plus mod, is allowed (and encouraged) for faster resets.

Use of unpatched boop is allowed, even on newer versions of the game.

If the IL is a Death Wish level, peace and tranquility is not allowed to be used.

---
Objective
---
Beat the game, collect all Time Pieces and Death Wish stamps as fast as possible!

The run begins after selecting yes on "Start new game." For this run, along with the main game time pieces, you must collect the five time pieces from Arctic Cruise, all ten in Nyakuza Metro, as well as the third spaceship rift. On top of this, you must collect all Death Wish stamps. Time ends on the collection of the last stamp or time piece needed, not the finale time piece cluster.

---
Category Specific Rules
---
- Returning to the main menu is inevitable due to tour only spawning after collecting 55 time pieces. Due to this, exiting to main menu during the credits cutscene after finale is allowed
- On DLC 2 patches, due to a bug where the timer resets upon first re-entry, an immediate save and quit is allowed to fix the IGT.
- IGT Restorer is allowed to alleviate the above bug.
- The usage of the slomo command to speed up the final game cutscene after collecting the Finale time piece is allowed.

name: Co-op
rules:
Base game category rules apply here.

Local cooperative mode is to be submitted only in the "Local" subcategory, the rest of the subcategories are online party exclusive (2p, 3p, 4p and 5p+).

# Local Co-op

The run is timed IGT, and begins upon selecting "yes" to creating a new file.

# Online Co-op

Runs must contain all perspectives linked, or edited into one video. The run is timed using RTA, and begins upon selecting "yes" to creating a new file.

Both in game timers (full game and act) are still required to be on at all times.

The mod "Online Party Super Syncing" and "Enhanced Join Act Menu" are allowed for use in this category.

name: DLC
rules:
- [Pусский](https://docs.google.com/document/d/11EEqRcQLu4IFqr_wvaBwfpA7CRc0EZujBQ1VIsJwLlo/edit#heading=h.wza472een65l) - @Facejif

Co-op rules:

- The run has to be played out by two players. Each player must use separate characters and input devices.

- Player two must join before entering the first stage/boss (tutorial stage is considered a stage/boss)

- Joining during a stage/boss already in progress is not allowed. This includes the removal and rejoining of player two.

- No player can leave the screen for more than five seconds without being parried or revived. This is referred to as “The Five Second Rule”.

- Any boss fight needed to complete a run must be entered and completed by both players. If a knockout is achieved within the bounds of the five second rule, then the fight will be considered valid.

- Any non boss stage needed to complete a run must be entered with both players but does not need to be completed by both players. There will be no five second rule penalty applied to these stages. 

- There are two valid options for the resurrection of a player that reaches zero hp and becomes a ghost during the course of a boss fight. They are as followed:                                                       

• The living player must revive their partner's ghost by performing a parry within the area of play.

• The non living player may utilize a self revival by pressing “esc/start” at the cost of one HP from the living player. This method must be performed within the bounds of the five second rule.

- Sticky Ghosts are allowed to be utilized as long as the non living player's ghost is either visible, or the living player can prove the ghost has been successfully stuck within the area of play by using the ghost to perform a parry within the remainder of the fight. If a ghost can not be seen on screen and has not been proven to have been successfully stuck within the aforementioned time frame, the fight will not be considered valid and will need to be beaten again before continuing the run.

Online play through alternate means, such as Parsec, is allowed.

- If a player dies while a fight is still in progress, they have to either be revived before their ghost leaves the area of play, or they have to rejoin within 5 seconds of their ghost leaving the screen (the dead player has to press start if using controller or esc if using keyboard to steal an HP from the living player). If "A knockout!" appears and one of the two players is still visible on screen in ghost form, they are allowed to not be revived during the screen fade-out. This rule does not apply to run 'n gun stages, those can be finished with only one player alive.

- Online play through alternate means, such as Parsec, is allowed.



Playing on a clean file, unlock Hell while only completing stages on the Simple difficulty. Timer ends on selecting difficulty on "All Bets Are Off!".

All of the game rules apply.

name: ARCHIVE: AB Menu Glitch, Simple
rules:
Archive notes: This category contains all the runs from the old All Bosses Menu Glitch - Solo, Simple, Legacy category. The regular runs got moved to Any%, and all the other subcategories were empty.

Playing on a clean file, defeat all main bosses (i.e. you don't have to beat all 9 of King Dice's "minibosses") on a single difficulty. 

You are allowed to use the Menu Glitch in this category. Please refrain from submitting in this category if you have not used this glitch.

For Expert, you must use the Fresh Expert Glitch. See: [link](https://www.docs.google.com/document/d/1OEchIopd8IqfKu283U0rWYzN44mg-OJSR9pnlSp3UyE/edit#) (towards bottom of document under Glitches - Difficulty).

General Rules:
- Timer starts on file select.
- See subcategory rules for timer end point.
- Switching difficulties during the run is not allowed.
- Runs must be completed in a single segment. Pauses are allowed, but the timer must remain running. If not, we will add the time in manually.
- PC runs have the option to use the autosplitter/load remover. If they do, submit loadless time.
- Xbox runs (or non-load removed PC runs) should submit RTA as "time with loads."
- VSync is not allowed if you have a monitor with a refresh rate higher than 60Hz. In such cases, VSync must remain off. If your monitor is 60Hz or less, you have the option to leave it on.
- Aside from Fresh Expert Glitch, runs should not make use of data/setup from another save or profile (i.e. Apple text skip, world warping, etc. are not allowed)
- Third party software, other than keybinders, are not allowed. If using a keybinder, you must set it up to be 1-to-1. That is to say, an action must be linked to one and only one button. (Example: Jump can't be linked to both A and X.) You also cannot map a button to another button. (Example: The X button can't be linked to the A button). Macros and turbos are not allowed. 
- Please refrain from submitting runs with in-game time attached.

Proof Guidelines:
- You must provide a recording of the FULL run.
- The bottom left corner (HP and equipped weapon) must be visible. For Co-Op, bottom right corner must be visible as well.
- If using the load remover, the loadless timer must be visible in the recording at all times.
